item: TODO24 Project-type detection and capability gating
original_requirement: Original TODO24: detect ecosystem at index time from csproj/sln, package.json, Cargo.toml and pyproject; use it to gate WebForms/migration tools out of the visible tool list, select extractor presets and tailor get_codebase_overview output.
demonstrated: Omitted/auto indexing type selects JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, ordinary C# or WebForms presets from admitted paths. Mixed projects retain all authored source files through general coverage.
Project information and the existing overview summary expose matching ecosystem evidence, capability flags, preset and coverage from the published source manifest.

Non-WebForms projects and an empty registry omit WebForms migration tools. Multiple projects retain the union of useful specialized tools; explicit WebForms aliases retain access without claiming detected page evidence.
Deleting WebForms markup from a mixed project changes capability discovery only after update_project publishes it. Source recovery, reopen and limited-profile dependencies are verified.
Existing registrations bypass automatic rescanning. A prior-version source index remains readable without reindexing or changing its preset.
limitations: Detection uses eligible manifest/source file names; it does not execute builds, resolve dependencies, or prove runtime behavior.
Indexing presets are fixed at registration. Explicit profiles are honored; metadata covers their selected source paths and ignore rules, not excluded working-tree files.

Metadata describes the held published source generation. Run update_project to reflect disk edits. Legacy/unavailable source coverage is explicit and conservatively retains specialized tool discovery.
Tool visibility is a union across registered projects, intersected with full/core configuration. Clients should re-list after background indexing finishes; direct calls remain supported.
Evidence output is bounded and reports omissions. Parent manual review only; no external review or full original nineteen-gate closure. Production source was not reindexed.

temporary_resources.cleanup_condition: Retain package, complete old pair, journals and evidence. No preexisting folder deletion authorized.

broader_goal: ACTIVE; remaining accepted original backlog and unfinished gates remain open.
